title: Canadian Biomass 2025 Pellet Mill Map
licence: Public PDF; factual capacity figures extracted with attribution. The PDF itself is not redistributed.
coverage: 43 current Canadian pellet producers; 4 proposed excluded
notes: Current-producer table only. Capacities are finished pellet tonnes/yr; converted to m3 at 650 kg/m3 and labelled published_capacity_converted. Proposed plants are excluded.

title: Solid Biofuels Bulletin No. 4: Graded Wood Pellets
licence: Government of Canada publication; factual bulk-density range cited, not reproduced.
coverage: Bulk density 600-750 kg/m3 for graded wood pellets
notes: CAN/CSA-ISO 17225-2 bulk-density range 600-750 kg/m3. The planning conversion uses 650 kg/m3, inside that range.

title: OpenStreetMap Nominatim city-centroid geocoding
access_method: Public HTTP API, one query per city, 2026-11-22
notes: City centroids are not plant-gate coordinates and carry location uncertainty; co-located records use the existing facility coordinate instead.
